headline: Tibo's Day 27/28 | Two banked resets
originalTimeText: Next two days will be resets… banked…
scope: Banked resets announced for the next two series days, Day 27 and Day 28. Eligible accounts, delivery times and expiration were not specified.

announcement.text: Day 26/ You can now easily switch between multiple accounts on mobile, and coming soon to desktop too. Next two days will be resets… banked… do with this what you may 👀.
announcement.translation: 第 26 天：现在可以在手机端轻松切换多个账号，桌面端也即将支持。接下来两天会有重置……储备重置……你们看着安排吧 👀。

note: The Day 26 post was published on October 30 in US Pacific time. In the series calendar the next two days are Day 27 (October 31 PT) and Day 28 (November 1 PT). This is an announcement, not confirmation of delivery; no exact countdown or account eligibility is inferred.
